overview:
The **Fifth Battle of Ruusan** (1001 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **New Sith Wars**, fought on or above **Ruusan**. Sith counteroffensive breaking jedi perimeter defenses on ruusan canyon passes with brotherhood warlords fighting among themselves.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the New Sith Wars in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Fifth Battle of Ruusan within the broader **New Sith Wars** campaign. Front-line reports describe sith counteroffensive breaking jedi perimeter defenses on ruusan canyon passes with brotherhood warlords fighting among themselves.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **1001 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the New Sith Wars.
significance: The Fifth Battle of Ruusan illustrates how the New Sith Wars reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
